aggregation.pooled_fallback_to_vanilla_rate: total fallback cells divided by total shared-grid cells
aggregation.selection_rate: mean task-level selection indicator after configured repeat and configuration aggregation

fallback_columns.fallback_to_vanilla_rate: shared-grid cell rate using canonical vanilla after selection, support, and non-finite fallback
fallback_columns.nonfinite_fallback: whether a finite-grid prediction was replaced by vanilla
fallback_columns.nonfinite_fallback_windows: mean fallback-window count across selected repeats/configurations
fallback_columns.task_fallback: whether this method used its task-level fallback

metric_columns.scaled_MASE: task MASE divided by matching Seasonal Naive MASE
